nodes.name: Schedule 17:00 and 05:00 JST
nodes.notes: 1h after WF09 (16:00/04:00 JST). Keep OFF until the integration test passes. WF10 never writes to Notion.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: prune_mode DRY_RUN (candidates only) until you set LIVE. alert_webhook_url empty = log-only. n8n_api_base e.g. https://<host>/api/v1 enables failed-execution detection (needs an n8n API key credential). exec_pruning_confirmed: set true ONLY after the instance runs EXECUTIONS_DATA_PRUNE=true and EXECUTIONS_DATA_MAX_AGE=72 (execution data contains PII). workflow_ids_json maps n8n workflow ids to WFxx names.

nodes.name: Get Queue
nodes.notes: Read-only. Full queue (needed for duplicate/prune checks).

nodes.name: Lead Schema
nodes.notes: Schema only (property ids). No lead data.

nodes.name: Build Lead Query
nodes.notes: PII guard: only 8 non-PII columns via filter_properties; refuses (harmless users/me call) if any id is unresolved.

nodes.name: Lead Query
nodes.notes: READ only. Response is re-checked in Plan Monitor: any non-allow-listed column => data discarded + HIGH finding.

nodes.name: Exec Fetch
nodes.notes: Execution list WITHOUT data (includeData=false): metadata only.

nodes.name: Plan Monitor
nodes.notes: READ-ONLY analysis. Emits only: fix (R1), prune_queue, prune_state, one digest.

nodes.name: Route Plan
nodes.notes: No fallback: any other kind is dropped.

nodes.name: Queue Fix R1
nodes.notes: R1 only: stale PUBLISHING -> MANUAL_REVIEW (AMBIGUOUS_PUBLISH). Never a retry, never PUBLISHED.

nodes.name: Prune Queue Row
nodes.notes: Only emitted in prune_mode=LIVE; whitelist: old DRY_RUN / old FAILED (+PUBLISHED only if explicitly enabled).

nodes.name: Prune State Row
nodes.notes: Only emitted in prune_mode=LIVE; old RESOLVED rows only.

nodes.name: Send Digest
nodes.notes: PII-free text digest only. No retry here: a failed send is retried next run (last_alerted not advanced).

nodes.name: Finalize
nodes.notes: last_alerted advances only after a 2xx answer (or in log-only mode).
